hospital.line: No one laughs at God in a hospital
hospital.lineNext: No one laughs at God in a war

hospital.line: I hate living by the hospital
stanza: I hate living by the hospital
I used to joke that if they woke you up
Sick of the questions I keep asking you
That make you live in the past
But I can count on you to tell me the truth
When you've been drinking and you're wearing a mask

hospital.line: I said, "Okay, but let's discuss this at the hospital"
stanza: I push it back, but it keeps on coming
And being clever never got me very far
Because it's all in my head
I said, "Okay, but let's discuss this at the hospital"
